changelog:
- Powerful Hybrid Architecture: Combined high-speed network-level blocking with domain-scoped surgical scriptlets (matching uBlock Origin and Brave Browser).
- Official uBlock Origin / Brave Scriptlets: Bundled official resources.json (583KB) for automatic +js(...) rule execution via Brave adblock-rust C-FFI engine.
- YouTube Media Enhancer & SponsorBlock: Open-source SponsorBlock automatically skips in-video sponsors, intros, and promos, while clean native skipper clicks ads instantly with 0ms buffering delay.
- Scoped News & Article CMP Defuser: Unlocks scroll-locks and dismisses modals on The Sun, Fox News, Forbes, and The Guardian without altering core prototypes or hiding article bodies.
- 100% Clean Social Feeds: Reddit, Instagram, Twitter, and social SPAs render with standard native layouts, 60fps smooth scrolling, and zero overlapping/stacked post cards.
- Network-Level Consent & Nag Blocking: Intercepts OneTrust, Cookiebot, Sourcepoint, and Funding Choices at the network layer.
- ClearURLs Tracking Stripper: Automatically strips fbclid, gclid, utm_*, igshid, and si query parameters.
